title: Senior Data Engineer, Mi-Platform
description:
Senior Data Engineer, Proprietary Research

London

A Career with Point72's Market Intelligence team

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence— you will uncover insights about markets and the broader economy through deep compliant fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques to alternative data sets. In partnership with our investment professionals and Compliance team, our team of analysts, data scientists and engineers work together to produce compliant research and build tools that inform our firm’s investments. We look for other bright, motivated, and collaborative people to join our team and grow with us—a majority of the leaders in our group were promoted from within.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Work closely with investment professionals, researchers, and data scientists to design, build, and launch robust end-to-end business solutions including data pipelines, products and tools.
  • Design and develop big data processing pipelines including but not limited to ingestion, transformation, trends creation to deliver AI-ready data assets & products.
  • Develop reusable software components, libraries, and APIs that enable rapid experimentation and production deployment
  • Implement data quality, lineage, and governance controls to ensure datasets are reliable, auditable, and compliant with compliance policies
  • Build scalable AI-native cloud-based infrastructure using distributed systems techniques, to deliver efficient data-driven business solutions
  • Optimize performance, cost, and reliability of software systems through benchmarking and iterative improvements

WHAT’S REQUIRED  

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering or related field
  • 2+ years of strong experience in Python development

title: Backend / Data Platform Engineer
description:
Backend / Data Platform Engineer This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.
 About us
 Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.
 We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.
 Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.
 We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.
 Position Overview
 London · Full time · On-site
 You'll build the platform that ingests, processes and serves our tracking data, all the way from station to customer API.
 What you'll do
 Build ingest pipelines from our stations and from third-party data sources
 Design data models and storage for high-volume, time-series scientific data
 Build and maintain customer APIs and data delivery in standard formats
 Make pipelines reliable, observable and secure, including for customers with strict data-handling requirements
 Work closely with front-end, geodesy and orbit determination engineers
 What you'll bring
 Extensive experience building backend systems in production
 Strong Python (or Go or Rust) and SQL
 Experience with data pipelines, message queues and time-series storage
 Cloud infrastructure and containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
 Care for testing, security and documentation
 Nice to have
 Scientific or geospatial data
 Space data standards (CCSDS, CRD)
 Streaming platforms such as Kafka…

title: Senior Data Engineer (Remote in Brazil)
description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.
 Position open to candidates located in Brazil . Please submit your resume in English.
 To learn more about our team and office culture in São Paulo, Brazil, visit the following links.
 Careers Page: https://www.knowbe4.com/careers/locations/sao-paulo
 Glassdoor : https://www.glassdoor.com/Location/KnowBe4-S%C3%A3o-Paulo-Location-EI_IE969384.0,7_IL[…]M_-C1lsxoZq7Cx8IriVE8MkrzuTmnJzqego77RAWZz9sqGt_55BflwYKpQeg
 LinkedIn : https://www.linkedin.com/company/knowbe4/life/brazil/
 This is a Data Platform Engineering seat. Your mission is to build the tooling, infrastructure, and pipelines that allow engineering and product teams to self-serve while reliably delivering high-integrity data to customer-facing applications, internal reporting, ML models, and autonomous AI agents.
 You will join the core team behind our data platform: an event-driven lakehouse on AWS handling tens of thousands of events per second. You will design, build, and operate the near-real-time pipelines that model product and service events through medallion layers using open table formats and analytical engines, delivered as strictly tested, peer-reviewed, and version-controlled software.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Advertising
description:
About Truelogic
 At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.
 Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.
 By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.
 Our Client
 Our client is a global technology and creative network that brings together engineering and creative expertise in equal measure to help businesses drive innovation, digital transformation, and long-term growth. As part of a leading global marketing and communications group, the company combines strategy, design, and technology to deliver end-to-end digital experiences and solutions. Its portfolio includes partnerships with some of the world's most recognized brands across industries such as technology, finance, media, sports, and consumer goods.
 Job Summary
 We are seeking a hands-on Senior Data Engineer to build scalable data infrastructure to support data-driven insights and predictive and generative AI models. The Senior Data Engineer will lead technical workstreams, contribute to defining data engineering best practices, and mentor other engineers while collaborating closely with Machine Learning Engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Who are we and why should you join us?
 BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.
 As a Senior Analytics Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.
 What are we looking for?
 We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help us build best-in-class data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data and keep pace with our accelerated growth. These products must be built and maintained using best practices so they stay scalable and earn stakeholder trust as we grow in both size and scope. This person will work cross-functionally with technical and business stakeholders across the company, and will optimize our data stack to deliver trustworthy, discoverable, impactful data, served to both people and the AI tools they increasingly rely on.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.
 Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.
 Responsibilities:
 Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives.
 Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data
 Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines.
 Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines

title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
description:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

 

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
